text.tspan: Cross-Tenant AI Gateway — Call Flow (one request)
Customer identity authenticates the caller; APIM validates the token; APIM's own identity authenticates to Foundry. No shared secrets.

text.tspan: 10) claude-haiku-4-5 completion returns the same path: Foundry → APIM → Private Link → VM web app → browser
black = data call purple = customer Entra token issuance red = cross-tenant Private Link orange = APIM identity → Foundry dashed = response / return
the customer identity proves WHO is calling (steps 2–6); APIM's own identity proves the GATEWAY to Foundry (steps 7–9). Two separate identities, zero shared secrets.
